title: Complexation of soybean beta-conglycinin and glycinin with phytic acid: Molecular insights and effects on structural and digestive properties.
authors: Zhang, Yujiao; Fei, Chengxin; Zhao, Ruojie; Dai, Oujun; Deng, Zhixiong; Fan, Bei; Wang, Fengzhong; Huang, Yatao
one_liner_zh: 该研究结合分子对接和MD模拟，探究植酸与大豆7S/11S蛋白的结合机制及其对结构和消化性的影响，虽以食品蛋白为对象，但结构计算建模方法可迁移至蛋白质体系。
abstract: This study investigated the complexation of phytic acid (PA) with soybean beta-conglycinin (7S) and glycinin (11S) and its effects on protein structure and digestibility. Complex formation was most pronounced near pH 3.0, accompanied by decreased solubility and enhanced aggregation. PA binding reduced beta-sheet content from 36.0% to 31.4% in 7S and from 37.3% to 35.1% in 11S, indicating conformational rearrangement. During simulated gastric digestion, hydrolysis decreased from 10.59% to 7.42% for 7S and from 9.93% to 6.92% for 11S, whereas hydrolysis increased during subsequent intestinal digestion. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations provided theoretical support for interpreting the experimental observations, suggesting contributions from electrostatic interactions and hydrogen bonding, with more extensive contacts predicted for PA-11S. Isothermal titration calorimetry confirmed a higher affinity of PA for 11S, with dissociation constants of 12.3 muM for 11S and 32.5 muM for 7S. At pH 3.0 and 37  degrees C, binding was enthalpically and entropically favorable for 7S but enthalpy-driven for 11S. These findings provide molecular insights into PA-soy protein interactions and their implications for protein hydrolysis during simulated gastrointestinal digestion.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了植酸（phytic acid, PA）与大豆β-伴大豆球蛋白（7S）及大豆球蛋白（11S）的复合形成及其对蛋白质结构和消化性的影响。复合形成在pH 3.0附近最为显著，伴随溶解度降低和聚集增强。PA结合使7S中β-折叠含量从36.0%降至31.4%，11S中从37.3%降至35.1%，表明构象重排。在模拟胃消化过程中，7S的水解度从10.59%降至7.42%，11S从9.93%降至6.92%，而在后续肠消化中水解度增加。分子对接和分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟为解释实验观察提供了理论支持，提示静电相互作用和氢键的贡献，并预测PA-11S具有更广泛的接触。等温滴定量热法（isothermal titration calorimetry）确认PA对11S具有更高亲和力，解离常数分别为11S的12.3 μM和7S的32.5 μM。在pH 3.0和37°C条件下，7S的结合在焓和熵上均有利，而11S的结合由焓驱动。这些发现为PA-大豆蛋白相互作用及其在模拟胃肠消化过程中对蛋白质水解的影响提供了分子层面的见解。
